lead: `docs/agent/loop-goal.toml` is CRLF and its `docs/agent/goals/<goal>.toml` copy is LF, so a plain `diff` of the pair reports every line as changed and buries the drift that matters.
body: Compare them with `diff --strip-trailing-cr`: run that way this pair differed by exactly the two `[context] modules` lines a session had added to the live copy alone, which the next `goal-switch.py` would have dropped. Write each file in its own ending, and read `git diff --numstat` afterwards to see that you did.
